info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, leftLoopX, rightLoopX, loopWidth, radians, Ypos, overlayState, startHeight, startWidth, cableGuy, splashHeight, splashVel, gravglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPausedon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  rightLoopX = 512 + (this.width / 2)  leftLoopX = -this.width / 2  loopWidth = 512 + this.width  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  this.locZ = 102  startHeight = this.height  startWidth = this.width  this.blend = 0  overlayState = #NULL  splashHeight = startHeight * 0.5  splashVel = 7  grav = -0.25endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case overlayState of      #NULL:        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos      #StartSplash:        this.blend = 100        this.height = startHeight * 0.5        this.width = startWidth        overlayState = #SPLASH        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos        splashHeight = 0        splashVel = 7      #SPLASH:        splashVel = splashVel + grav        splashHeight = splashHeight + splashVel        this.height = splashHeight        this.width = startWidth + 5 - (splashHeight * 0.10000000000000001)        if splashVel < 0 then          this.blend = this.blend - 1          if this.blend = 0 then            overlayState = #NULL            Xpos = -1000            Ypos = -1000          end if        end if        Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos    end case  end ifend
